messages.content: 一位化學家正在進行一個實驗，使用一個2公斤的特定物質A樣本。實驗開始時，該物質的初始溫度為攝氏25度。然後，化學家將物質加熱到最終溫度攝氏75度。該實驗在1大氣壓力下進行。化學家重複進行相同物質的實驗，但這次的初始溫度為攝氏10度，最終溫度為攝氏50度。你能計算出在這兩個實驗的設定初始和最終條件下，物質的熵變化嗎？

function.name: entropy_change_calculate
function.description: Calculate the change in entropy for a mass of a specific substance under set initial and final conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

substance.description: The substance for which the change in entropy is calculated.

mass.description: The mass of the substance in kg.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

pressure.description: The pressure the substance is under in atmospheres.

message.content:
**Entropy change for a solid/liquid (constant \(c_{p}\))**

For a material whose specific‑heat capacity at constant pressure (\(c_{p}\)) can be treated as constant over the temperature range considered, the reversible entropy change on heating from an initial temperature \(T_{\text{i}}\) to a final temperature \(T_{\text{f}}\) is  

\[
\Delta S \;=\; m\,c_{p}\,\ln\!\left(\frac{T_{\text{f}}}{T_{\text{i}}}\right)
\]

where  
\(m\) – mass of the sample (kg),  
\(T_{\text{i}},T_{\text{f}}\) – absolute temperatures (K).

---

### 1. First experiment  
- Mass \(m = 2\;\text{kg}\)  
- Initial temperature \(T_{\text{i}} = 25^{\circ}\text{C} = 298.15\;\text{K}\)  
- Final temperature \(T_{\text{f}} = 75^{\circ}\text{C} = 348.15\;\text{K}\)

\[
\Delta S_{1}= 2\,c_{p}\,\ln\!\left(\frac{348.15}{298.15}\right)
          = 2\,c_{p}\,\ln(1.1675)
          = 2\,c_{p}\,(0.1549)
          = 0.3098\,c_{p}\;\text{kJ/K}
\]

If the substance were water (\(c_{p}\approx 4.18\;\text{kJ/(kg·K)}\)), this would give  

\[
\boxed{\Delta S_{1}\approx 1.30\;\text{kJ/K}}
\]

---

### 2. Second experiment  
- Mass \(m = 2\;\text{kg}\)  
- Initial temperature \(T_{\text{i}} = 10^{\circ}\text{C} = 283.15\;\text{K}\)  
- Final temperature \(T_{\text{f}} = 50^{\circ}\text{C} = 323.15\;\text{K}\)

\[
\Delta S_{2}= 2\,c_{p}\,\ln\!\left(\frac{323.15}{283.15}\right)
          = 2\,c_{p}\,\ln(1.1415)
          = 2\,c_{p}\,(0.1323)
          = 0.2646\,c_{p}\;\text{kJ/K}
\]

With \(c_{p}=4.18\;\text{kJ/(kg·K)}\):

\[
\boxed{\Delta S_{2}\approx 1.10\;\text{kJ/K}}
\]

---

#### Summary (for water)

| Experiment | \(\Delta S\) (kJ/K) |
|------------|---------------------|
| 1 (25 °C → 75 °C) | ≈ **1.30** |
| 2 (10 °C → 50 °C) | ≈ **1.10** |

> **Note:**  
> • If the actual substance has a different \(c_{p}\), simply replace the numerical value in the formulas above.  
> • The calculations assume the process is carried out reversibly and that \(c_{p}\) remains essentially constant over the temperature interval.
